summary: Frontend-only test of the single activity-type filter injected by admin-extras.js into the 'Atividade em tempo real' card at /donaspainel. Login (donas) worked. The dropdown (data-testid=activity-filter-select) appears once, with a 'Filtrar' label, right above .dp-events, and has the 8 options in the right order. The default 'Todas' shows all 29/29 items. Each filter showed only matching items: acesso 18, cadastro 3, inscricao 3, pix_gerado 2, pix_copiado 1, comprovante 2, lembrete 0. After an AO VIVO refresh (new access event, picked up within about 5s), the 'Inscrições realizadas' filter was still applied: the new top item had data-dp-hidden=1 and the dropdown was still there with no duplicate. The selection also survived a page reload (localStorage), and resetting to 'Todas' showed all 30 items. All requested checks passed.

issues: If a filter matches nothing (for example 'Lembretes' right now), the feed is just blank with no empty-state message such as 'Nenhuma atividade deste tipo'.

action_items: Optional: show an empty-state message when the selected filter matches no feed items.

Optional: the filter only works on the items already loaded in the feed (the latest N events). Older events of a type (for example lembretes) are never shown. Consider filtering on the server if that matters.
critical_code_review_comments: kindOf() classifies items by keywords in the order acesso > cadastro > inscri > pix... A description that contains more than one keyword (for example a future 'PIX gerado - inscrição X' or a candidate name containing 'Cadastro') would be put in the wrong type. Classifying by event type (a data attribute or icon class) would be more robust if the bundle exposes one.
The selection is saved in localStorage, so the filter stays on after a reload. That may be intended, but an admin could come back and think events are missing.
seed_data_creation: Sent one POST /api/track/access with visitor_id TEST_filter_<ts> to trigger a feed refresh. This added one 'Novo acesso desktop' event and one access record.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login inputs: first <input> is the username, input[type=password] is the password, then press Enter. The filter shows up right after .dp-events renders. Feed items: .dp-event with .desc. Hidden items have data-dp-hidden=1. The filter value is stored in localStorage key dp_activity_filter.
